status: Design proposal only; navigation changes are not implemented.
prompt:
Use case ui-mockup. Generate a high-fidelity Chinese Android cooking app HEADER REDESIGN COMPARISON BOARD, two large front-facing flat mobile screens side by side, landscape canvas approx 1536x1200, clean warm white background. Each screen ratio 390:844, sharp readable Chinese. App 小灶. Reference image 1 is the USER APPROVED LOGO: the three steam strokes reminiscent of 小 above a little cooking pot, with rounded dark-brown 小灶 wordmark. Use that SAME logo identity faithfully and at a practical small header scale on both screens. Reference image 2 is the EXISTING LIVE INGREDIENT SCREEN for real function/content guidance only; do not duplicate its old text+flame logo. Do not use the concept-board title or labels inside the app.

The app color scheme is FIXED: tomato red #B83225, warm white #FFFDF8, dark brown #38251D, pale warm surface #F6F0E7, line #E7DDD1, selected ingredient light yellow #FFF0B8. No new color theme, no purple, green, orange, no gradients/glass/shadows everywhere, no marketing copy. Logo should look like reference approved design, not a stock saucepan icon. Same functional content and typography below headers to compare fairly. Do not introduce account/avatar, weather, meal times, user greeting, notification bell, AI badge, recipe count or decorative quote.

LEFT concept title outside phone: "方案 1 · 轻量工具栏". At top app safe area, a clean horizontal 64px brand bar, logo left width about 120px and height40, right a single neatly shaped light-warm 2-button toolbar containing clearly separated outlined magnifying-glass (find recipes) and gear (settings), each approximately48px hit target, no nested fake controls. Small subtle 1px warm separator underneath, REMOVE old full-width gingham/checkered line. Warm white background, refined generous spacing not bare sparse. Main heading "今天有什么食材？" below, bold 28px. Existing input "添加食材" and separate red + button below it. This design feels like a considered daily-use app, light and neat.
RIGHT concept title outside phone: "方案 2 · 一体式页头". The ENTIRE top area from logo through title and input uses a restrained pale-warm #F6F0E7 background, with a gentle rounded lower edge around24px. This is one integrated panel, NOT floating stacked cards. Top row same new logo left; right an outlined quiet rounded button with gear and text "设置", hit target48px, no extra search toolbar. Below within panel heading "今天有什么食材？", then white input "添加食材" with red + button. Keep total height of this area similar to the combined left header/title/input, not adding wasted space. Below panel selected-food chips and normal content continue on warm white background. More coherent homelike rhythm, subtle not oversaturated.

BOTH phones content after header/input: selected chips "番茄 ×", "鸡蛋 ×", "牛肉 需细分"; separate modest text action "选择具体食材". Two clear expandable rows "常用与分类食材", "常备调料". A section "看看能做什么", and a modest photo+text recipe row for "番茄炒鸡蛋", "15 分钟  2 人份", heart and basket actions. Natural homemade tomato-and-eggs photo, never a massive hero that displaces the ingredient input. Four fixed bottom navigation icons plus labels "食材", "找菜", "菜篮", "收藏", 食材 selected tomato red. A SINGLE circular floating kitchen stopwatch just above bottom nav at lower right, visibly independent from header and not touching controls. No giant countdown. Body text17px, headers28px, 48px tap zones, 20px content side margins, sensible vertical density. New top header must be the visible focus of comparison but show full app context. Android status bar, no iPhone notch. Outside phones only the two concept labels, no long explanatory prose. This is a proposal only, not a claim of implementation.
